# openv-mcp JSON-RPC 2.0 over stdio (MCP 2024-11-05), served the way
# cmd/openv-mcp serves it: ServeStdio(NewClient(<stub API>, "run-token-golden"), Tools()).
# ">" is a line written to stdin; "<" is the exact line written back to
# stdout (one JSON object per newline-terminated line); "=" is a REST request
# the stub OpenV API received while that line was served.
# Generated by TestMCPJSONRPCGolden in internal/mcp.
# OPENV_MCP_TOOLS=mcp__openv__get_vv_gaps,list_projects

# initialize: the protocol version and the server name and version are fixed
> {"jsonrpc":"2.0","id":1,"method":"initialize","params":{"protocolVersion":"2024-11-05","capabilities":{},"clientInfo":{"name":"golden","version":"0"}}}
< {"jsonrpc":"2.0","id":1,"result":{"capabilities":{"tools":{}},"protocolVersion":"2024-11-05","serverInfo":{"name":"openv-mcp","version":"0.1.0"}}}

# the initialized notification gets no response
> {"jsonrpc":"2.0","method":"notifications/initialized"}
< (no response)

# ping; a string id is echoed back as the same raw JSON
> {"jsonrpc":"2.0","id":"ping-1","method":"ping"}
< {"jsonrpc":"2.0","id":"ping-1","result":{}}

# tools/list: the tools OPENV_MCP_TOOLS admits, in table order
> {"jsonrpc":"2.0","id":2,"method":"tools/list"}
< {"jsonrpc":"2.0","id":2,"result":{"tools":[{"description":"List all projects visible to this agent.","inputSchema":{"properties":{},"required":[],"type":"object"},"name":"list_projects"},{"description":"Traceability and verification gaps in a project: requirements with no verification method, with no test case, unverified (requirements_unverified — method demonstration, analysis or inspection and not yet marked verified), or whose latest results fail, plus orphan test cases, user needs no requirement derives from, and unmitigated hazards. Each is a list of artifact IDs.","inputSchema":{"properties":{"project_id":{"description":"Project ID","type":"string"}},"required":["project_id"],"type":"object"},"name":"get_vv_gaps"}]}}

# a successful tools/call: the API body, trimmed, is the one text block
> {"jsonrpc":"2.0","id":3,"method":"tools/call","params":{"name":"list_projects","arguments":{}}}
= GET /api/v1/projects (Authorization: Bearer run-token-golden)
< {"jsonrpc":"2.0","id":3,"result":{"content":[{"text":"[{\"id\":\"11111111-1111-4111-8111-111111111111\",\"name\":\"Pump controller\"}]","type":"text"}],"isError":false}}

# a tools/call the API refuses is a result with isError, not a JSON-RPC error
> {"jsonrpc":"2.0","id":4,"method":"tools/call","params":{"name":"get_vv_gaps","arguments":{"project_id":"11111111-1111-4111-8111-111111111111"}}}
= GET /api/v1/projects/11111111-1111-4111-8111-111111111111/vv/gaps (Authorization: Bearer run-token-golden)
< {"jsonrpc":"2.0","id":4,"result":{"content":[{"text":"API 403: {\"error\":\"forbidden\",\"code\":\"forbidden\"}\n{\"error\":\"forbidden\",\"code\":\"forbidden\"}","type":"text"}],"isError":true}}

# a tool the allowlist leaves out is an unknown tool (-32602)
> {"jsonrpc":"2.0","id":5,"method":"tools/call","params":{"name":"create_artifact","arguments":{"project_id":"11111111-1111-4111-8111-111111111111"}}}
< {"jsonrpc":"2.0","id":5,"error":{"code":-32602,"message":"unknown tool create_artifact"}}

# tools/call params that are not an object (-32602)
> {"jsonrpc":"2.0","id":6,"method":"tools/call","params":[1,2]}
< {"jsonrpc":"2.0","id":6,"error":{"code":-32602,"message":"invalid params"}}

# an unknown method with an id (-32601)
> {"jsonrpc":"2.0","id":7,"method":"resources/list"}
< {"jsonrpc":"2.0","id":7,"error":{"code":-32601,"message":"method not found: resources/list"}}

# an unknown notification gets no response
> {"jsonrpc":"2.0","method":"notifications/cancelled","params":{"requestId":3}}
< (no response)

# a line that is not JSON (-32700, id null)
> this is not json
< {"jsonrpc":"2.0","id":null,"error":{"code":-32700,"message":"parse error"}}

# the loop keeps serving after a parse error
> {"jsonrpc":"2.0","id":8,"method":"ping"}
< {"jsonrpc":"2.0","id":8,"result":{}}
